name: Exp_AroonSignal
summary: This EA trades based on the custom AroonSignal indicator, entering long when an up-signal appears and short when a down-signal appears. It uses Aroon overbought/oversold levels to detect momentum shifts and manages positions with fixed stop-loss and take-profit. A historical bar scan searches backward for the last signal direction to determine close signals when no new signal is present.
summary_zh: 该EA基于自定义AroonSignal指标进行交易，当出现上行信号时做多，出现下行信号时做空。它利用Aroon超买/超卖水平检测动量变化，并使用固定止损和止盈管理仓位。当没有新信号时，会回溯历史K线寻找最近信号方向以确定平仓信号。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Aroon指标检测价格动量的变化方向，当Aroon上轨信号触发时判断为上升趋势动量增强而做多，当Aroon下轨信号触发时判断为下降趋势动量增强而做空。入场条件是AroonSignal指标缓冲区0（上轨信号）或缓冲区1（下轨信号）在指定SignalBar上出现非零且非EMPTY_VALUE的值。出场条件包括止损止盈的硬性平仓，以及当允许买卖双向持仓和平仓时，通过回溯历史K线寻找最近的反向信号来触发平仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值表示固定手数，正值表示按存款比例计算手数。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh中的BuyPositionOpen和SellPositionOpen函数实现，支持按账户余额百分比或固定手数两种模式。策略默认使用H4周期和9期Aroon参数，属于中长期动量跟踪型系统。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on the Aroon indicator detecting shifts in price momentum direction, going long when the Aroon up-signal triggers and short when the Aroon down-signal triggers. Entry conditions require the AroonSignal indicator buffer 0 (up-signal) or buffer 1 (down-signal) to produce a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE value on the specified SignalBar. Exit conditions include hard stop-loss and take-profit closures, plus a historical bar scan that searches backward to find the most recent opposite signal to trigger position closes when both opening and closing permissions are enabled. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter, where negative values represent fixed lot sizes and positive values represent deposit-share-based lot calculation. Money management relies on the BuyPositionOpen and SellPositionOpen functions from TradeAlgorithms.mqh, supporting both account-balance percentage and fixed lot modes. The strategy defaults to H4 timeframe with a 9-period Aroon parameter, classifying it as a medium-to-long-term momentum-following system.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款比例或固定手数，负值为手数
parameters.description_en: Deposit percentage or fixed lot; negative value = lot size

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于成熟的Aroon动量指标，信号定义明确
提供完整的买卖开关控制，灵活性高，可单独禁用买入或卖出
具有止损止盈保护机制，风险有硬性边界限制
使用IsNewBar检查避免同一K线内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
Recount机制确保数据复制失败时会重试，增强健壮性
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on the well-established Aroon momentum indicator with precisely defined signals
Full buy/sell permission switches provide high flexibility, allowing independent disabling of buy or sell operations
Hard stop-loss and take-profit protection ensures risk has defined boundaries
IsNewBar check prevents repeated trading within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Recount mechanism ensures data copy failures trigger retries, improving robustness
cons: 历史回溯平仓逻辑可能遍历大量K线，在长无信号区间内效率低下且可能产生错误平仓
没有点差过滤机制，在流动性差的市场中可能因高点差而遭受滑点损失
依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库文件，核心交易逻辑不可见，难以审计和验证
止损1000点和止盈2000点的默认值过大，可能在某些品种上不合适
没有多时间框架确认或额外过滤条件，单一指标信号容易产生虚假信号
cons_en: The historical bar scan for closing positions may iterate over many bars, being inefficient and potentially producing incorrect close signals during long no-signal periods
No spread filter mechanism, which may cause slippage losses in low-liquidity markets with high spreads
Depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library with invisible core trading logic, making auditing and verification difficult
Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are excessively large and may be unsuitable for certain instruments
No multi-timeframe confirmation or additional filter conditions, making single-indicator signals prone to false signals
improvements: 增加点差过滤和波动率过滤器（如ATR），避免在高点差或低波动环境下开仓
为历史回溯平仓搜索设置最大回溯K线数量限制，避免无限遍历和不合理的平仓信号
增加多时间框架确认或额外指标过滤（如趋势线、成交量），降低虚假信号率
improvements_en: Add spread filter and volatility filter (e.g., ATR) to avoid opening positions in high-spread or low-volatility environments
Set a maximum lookback bar limit for the historical closing signal search to prevent infinite iteration and unreasonable close signals
Add multi-timeframe confirmation or additional indicator filters (e.g., trend line, volume) to reduce false signal rate

risk_points: 历史回溯平仓逻辑可能产生与当前市场状态不符的过时平仓信号
核心交易逻辑封装在外部库中不可审计，可能存在隐藏风险
默认止损止盈点数极大，在小波动品种上可能导致单笔亏损过大
risk_points_en: Historical lookback closing logic may produce stale close signals inconsistent with current market conditions
Core trading logic is encapsulated in an external library that cannot be audited, potentially hiding risks
Default stop-loss and take-profit point values are extremely large, which may cause excessive single-trade losses on low-volatility instruments
